pair.intro: See the locks and running queries of your databases from your phone. Connections and passwords stay on your computer.
pair.name: Name of this phone
pair.step1: On the computer, open DBine › Settings › Devices.
pair.step2: Turn on “Allow phones” and tap “Pair a phone”.
pair.step3: Scan the code that appears. If the phone isn't on the same network, it connects over the internet (if DBine allows it in “Outside the local network”).
pair.compare: Check that the computer shows this same code:
pair.noCamera: Without permission to use the camera, the code can't be read.
pair.fromLink: You're about to pair this phone with “{{desktop}}”. Then you confirm on that computer that the code is the same.
pair.alreadyPaired: This phone is already paired with “{{desktop}}”. To pair it with another computer, unpair it first.

connections.unpairConfirm: Unpair this phone? To use it again you have to scan a new code.

activity.none: No queries are running or finished recently.

{{sql}}
activity.cancelled: Cancellation of the query was requested.
activity.hint: Here you see the queries you run in the DBine editor while they run, and those that took more than 10 seconds once they finish. If you allow it, the phone notifies you when they finish: with the app open, right away; with the app closed, on Android's next check (every 15 minutes). While a query has been running for more than 30 seconds, DBine keeps the computer from going to sleep.
activity.cancelNotAllowed: To cancel queries from this phone, enable it in DBine › Settings › Devices.
